questions.question: How is Clara different from other CRMs
questions.answer: Clara doesn’t just store data—it understands it. From summarizing customer interactions to suggesting next steps, Clara is like a co-pilot that helps you move faster with more confidence.

questions.question: Can Clara help my team save time?
questions.answer: Yes, Clara automates routine tasks and provides AI-powered insights to help your team focus on what matters most.

questions.question: Is Clara hard to set up?
questions.answer: No, Clara is designed for easy integration and quick setup with your existing tools and workflows.

questions.question: What tools does Clara integrate with?
questions.answer: Clara integrates with a wide range of tools including CRM systems, email platforms, and scheduling software.
